# Tenant-isolation matrix

<!-- generated by backend/scripts/tenant_isolation_matrix.py -->

Generated by running two synthetic tenants (`matrix-alice` and
`matrix-bob`) against a throwaway SQLite database and attempting each
cross-tenant operation through production code. Do not edit by hand;
regenerate with `python backend/scripts/tenant_isolation_matrix.py`.

A **PASS** cell means user A could not read, change, export, queue or
receive user B's data for that surface. **N/A** means the operation does
not apply to that surface.

## Probe detail

| Surface | Operation | Result | Probe |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| AI contexts | receive | PASS | Each AI context carries the owner whose data produced it |
| AI provider credentials | read | PASS | Resolve returns only the caller's secret; Alice cannot resolve Bob's provider |
| AI provider credentials | change | PASS | Bob's AI key is unchanged by Alice's credential operations |
| Background job queue | queue | PASS | Each job received its own owner; an unknown owner was denied before work |
| Browser sessions | read | PASS | Session lookup is owner-scoped; Alice cannot enumerate Bob's session |
| Browser sessions | change | PASS | Revoking Bob's sessions advances only Bob's session epoch |
| Connector credentials | read | PASS | Resolve returns only the caller's secret; Alice cannot resolve Bob's provider |
| Connector credentials | change | PASS | Rotating Alice's connector key does not touch Bob's |
| Connector sync cursors | read | PASS | Cursor keys bind the owner; Alice reads back only her own cursor value |
| Connector sync cursors | change | PASS | Advancing Alice's cursor cannot move Bob's |
| Credential audit trail | read | PASS | Alice's audit page contains only her credential events |
| Notifications and push delivery | read | PASS | Alice's notification query returns only her notification |
| Notifications and push delivery | change | PASS | Alice cannot mark Bob's notification read |
| Notifications and push delivery | receive | PASS | Push subscriptions resolve per owner; Alice never receives Bob's endpoint |
| Owner-scoped caches | read | PASS | Owner is a key segment; Alice's cache entry is unreachable from Bob's key |
| Owner-scoped caches | change | PASS | Writing Bob's cache key leaves Alice's entry untouched |
| User data export | export | PASS | Export envelope built only from Alice-scoped reads; no Bob rowid present |
| body_metrics | read | PASS | Alice sees only her rowid; Bob sees only his; neither sees the other |
| body_metrics | change | PASS | Alice-scoped UPDATE/DELETE matched no rows; Bob's row survived |
